# Security Policy

NEONSWEEPER is a static, client-side game. It has no backend, no accounts, no
telemetry and no third-party runtime requests, so there is no server-side attack
surface and the repository contains no API keys or credentials.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use **GitHub Security Advisories** on this repository (Security tab →
Report a vulnerability) rather than opening a public issue. Include the affected
file, a short reproduction, and the browser/OS you used. Reports are usually
acknowledged within a few days.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest revision of `main`.
